title: Slider
description: Pick a number, or a range with two thumbs, by dragging along a track: steps or marks, a value label and tooltip, and a separate event when the user lets go.

support.notes: Native Angular: MnSlider. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

api.notes: Native Angular: MnSlider. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

vars.name: --slider-accent
vars.description: Color of the filled track and of the thumb border (defaults to the color prop's accent)

vars.name: --slider-thumb-size
vars.description: Width and height of the thumbs (every size)

vars.name: --slider-min-length
vars.description: Smallest length of a horizontal track, like the intrinsic size of a native range input (defaults to 10rem)

vars.name: --slider-gap
vars.description: Space between the track and the value label

examples.title: Pick a value
examples.description: [(value)] follows the drag and the keys; (changeEnd) fires once on release (or after a key press): save there. Arrows step, PageUp / PageDown move by 10%, Home / End jump to the bounds.

examples.title: Range and marks
examples.description: range selects [start, end] with two thumbs that cannot cross; [marks]="true" draws a tick per step.

translationResources.title: Slider
translationResources.description: Pick a number, or a range with two thumbs, by dragging along a track: steps or marks, a value label and tooltip, and a separate event when the user lets go.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A controlled value with showValue and a tooltip while dragging or focused. Each thumb is a role="slider": arrows step, PageUp / PageDown move by 10%, Home / End jump to min / max; clicking the track jumps there.

range.title: Range
range.description: range selects [start, end] with two thumbs that cannot cross (the closest thumb follows a track click). formatValue formats the tooltip and aria-valuetext; name submits two hidden inputs.

marks.title: Marks
marks.description: marks={true} draws one tick per step; an array of { value, label } draws labelled marks. step={null} (or snapToMarks) snaps to the marks only; getAriaValueText names the value for screen readers.

sizes-colors.title: Sizes and colors
sizes-colors.description: Three sizes and the five semantic colors of the filled track and the thumbs; the theme variables follow the light / dark modes.

committed.title: Save on release
committed.description: onChange follows every move; onChangeEnd fires once when the pointer is released (or after a key press). Save there instead of on every change.

disabled.title: Disabled, read-only and forms
disabled.description: disabled blocks the slider; readOnly keeps it focusable but fixed. Inside a FormControl it takes the label, the description and the invalid / disabled / read-only states.

SliderProps.value: Value (controlled): a number, or [start, end] with range; clamped to min..max and snapped
SliderProps.defaultValue: Initial value (uncontrolled); defaults to min, or [min, max] with range
SliderProps.range: Two thumbs selecting [start, end]; the thumbs cannot cross
SliderProps.step: Step between two values; null snaps to the marks only
SliderProps.marks: Ticks of the scale: an array of { value, label? }, or true for one tick per step (up to 101)
SliderProps.snapToMarks: Snaps the value to the closest mark instead of the step
SliderProps.onChange: Called with the new value while dragging and on each key press
SliderProps.onChangeEnd: Called with the final value when the interaction ends (pointer release, key press): save here
SliderProps.disabled: Disables the slider (inherited from an enclosing FormControl when not set)
SliderProps.readOnly: Focusable, but the user cannot change the value (inherited from an enclosing FormControl)
SliderProps.color: Semantic color of the filled track and the thumbs
SliderProps.showValue: Shows the value (formatted) after the track
SliderProps.tooltip: Shows the value in a bubble above a thumb while it is dragged, hovered or focused
SliderProps.formatValue: Formats a value for the value label, the tooltip and aria-valuetext
SliderProps.name: Name of the hidden form input(s); a range submits two entries
SliderProps.aria-label: Accessible label of the thumbs (range: suffixed with Minimum / Maximum); defaults to the FormControl label
SliderProps.aria-labelledby: id(s) of the element(s) labelling the thumbs
SliderProps.aria-describedby: Extra id(s) of elements describing the slider, merged with the FormControl helper / error text
SliderProps.getAriaValueText: aria-valuetext of a thumb (index 0, or 1 for the end thumb of a range); defaults to formatValue
SliderProps.style: Inline styles of the root element

cssVars.--slider-accent: Color of the filled track and of the thumb border (defaults to the color prop's accent)
cssVars.--slider-thumb-size: Width and height of the thumbs (every size)
cssVars.--slider-min-length: Smallest length of a horizontal track, like the intrinsic size of a native range input (defaults to 10rem)
cssVars.--slider-gap: Space between the track and the value label
cssVars.--slider-value-font-size: Font size of the value label and of the mark labels

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: value is an attribute (it seeds the value and is restored by form.reset()); minerva-change follows the drag and the keys. show-value and tooltip display the value.

range.title: Range
range.description: range with value="20,80" selects two values; the form submits two entries under name. formatValue is a property.

marks.title: Marks
marks.description: An empty marks attribute draws a tick per step; a JSON array draws labelled marks. step="null" snaps to the marks only; the getAriaValueText property names the values.

sizes-colors.title: Sizes and colors
sizes-colors.description: size and color are reflected attributes (also the :state(size-small), :state(color-success) ... custom states).

committed.title: Save on release
committed.description: minerva-change follows every move; minerva-change-end fires once on release (or after a key press): save there.

disabled.title: Disabled, read-only and invalid
disabled.description: disabled (also from a disabled fieldset) blocks the slider; readonly keeps it focusable and submitted; invalid sets aria-invalid.

events.input: The value changed while dragging or with a key (native-like).
events.minerva-change: The value changed while dragging or with a key (detail: { value }).
events.minerva-change-end: The interaction ended, on release or after a key press (detail: { value }): save here.

props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).
props.required: Form-associated flag; a slider always has a value, so it is never missing.

methods.blur: Removes the focus from the slider.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).

basic.title: Native example
basic.description: Drag the thumbs in this phone preview: onChange follows the drag, onChangeEnd fires on release; screen readers adjust each thumb with increment / decrement.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: orientation="vertical" runs the track from min (bottom) to max (top): drag up to increase, tap the track to jump there. It is 160 dp long by default; set a height in style to change it. Range, marks, the tooltip and the value label work the same way.
